_info: Mana balance. Each wife has her own 100-point pool. Only magic spends it. A full pool + slow regen lasts a whole day of normal magic (about 1 spell/summon per hour, 4-25 each). See README > Mana.

meditation._info: When Chrispy hasn't been around for afterMin, a wife meditates on a cushion/chair/bed (summons a cushion if none, costs mana; floor = floorRate speed). Stops at capRatio of max, never higher.
